elements.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 continues to prohibit the Company from participating in similar Internet projects and grants HDI an exclusive right to use the Deerskin brand for the specified site.

elements.element: Exclusivity is limited to a defined product category.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 limits exclusivity to Deerskin Products and substantially similar products, with illustrative examples.

elements.element: Exclusivity lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 applies the Company's exclusivity obligation only for twelve months from the Effective Date, notwithstanding the Agreement's potential renewal.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet service levels.
elements.evidence: The added operative sentence states that Section 6.1 exclusivity terminates automatically upon HDI's failure to meet any service level required under the Agreement.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet delivery dates.
elements.evidence: The added operative sentence states that Section 6.1 exclusivity terminates automatically upon HDI's failure to meet any delivery date required under the Agreement.
